description: Show the OpenSERP Cloud account behind OPENSERP_API_KEY: account (plan, credits_remaining) and lastResponse (request_id, credits used, engine) for the previous tool call in this session. Read-only and free. Use it to check the balance before a large batch or to see what a call cost. Self-hosted mode has no credits, so it returns an error there.
name: get_usage
title: Get Usage
